name: SPAN 6407
title: Special Topics in Modern Spanish Cultural Production
description: Spanish culture from the Enlightenment to the present. Emphasis on the interaction of art and social thought, on the relations between art and the media, or on the role of intellectual practices in shaping or challenging notions of gender, ethnic, and national identity. May be repeated for a total of 9 credits.
requirement_description: No requirements to take this course.
